181.

183.   $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
184. 
185.   $lines = Get-Content -Path $LogPath
186.   $text = $lines -join "`n"
187. 
188.   $resultLine = Get-LastJsonLine -Path $LogPath -Pattern '"type":"result"'

194.   }

211.     toolStarts = $toolStarts
212.     toolCompletes = $toolCompletes
213.     toolCalls = $toolCalls
214.     tokenSeen = ($text -match [regex]::Escape($Token))
215.     exactTokenMessageSeen = ($text -match ('"content":"' + [regex]::Escape($Token) + '"'))
216.     sessionDurationMs = $resultLine.usage.sessionDurationMs
217.     totalApiDurationMs = $resultLine.usage.totalApiDurationMs
218.     premiumRequests = $resultLine.usage.premiumRequests
219.     logPath = $LogPath

 function Invoke-CopilotRun {
   param(
     [string]$ModeName,
